releaseSummary: The **Stock Order Form** is available from the header app launcher and global search.
Stock-order account selection now shows only lab accounts with priced stock-lens rows.
Adding a stock order to drafts persists the staged order and makes it reopenable from the quotations page.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Stock Order Form Discovery and Drafts.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
